question: In May 2025, who took charge as the new Vice Chief of the Air Staff?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Air Marshal Narmdeshwar Tiwari**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• Air Marshal Narmdeshwar Tiwari assumed charge as the **Vice Chief of the Air Staff** in May 2025.
 
• He has an extensive career in the Indian Air Force (IAF) and brings decades of experience in operational planning and strategic leadership.
 
• Prior to this appointment, Air Marshal Tiwari served as the **AOC-in-C (Air Officer Commanding-in-Chief)** of a key command in the IAF.
 
• He is recognized for his contributions towards enhancing India’s aerial defense capabilities.
 
• Air Marshal Tiwari has been awarded several prestigious military honors for his service, including the **Ati Vishisht Seva Medal (AVSM)**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Vice Chief of the Air Staff**

 
 
• The Vice Chief of the Air Staff is the second-highest-ranking officer in the Indian Air Force, reporting directly to the Chief of the Air Staff.
 
• This position is critical in overseeing operations, strategy, and personnel management across the Air Force.
 
• The Vice Chief plays a pivotal role in executing defense policies and modernizing the air force infrastructure.
 
 
 
• **Indian Air Force (IAF)**
 
 
• The IAF was officially established on **October 8, 1932**, and is one of the most powerful air forces globally.
 
• The primary mission of the IAF is to secure Indian airspace and conduct aerial warfare during armed conflicts.
 
• It operates a wide range of aircraft, including fighter jets, transport planes, helicopters, and UAVs.
 
 
 
• **Awards and Honors in the Indian Armed Forces**
 
 
• The **Ati Vishisht Seva Medal (AVSM)** is awarded for distinguished service of an exceptional order.
 
• Other prominent awards include the Param Vishisht Seva Medal (PVSM) and the Vishisht Seva Medal (VSM).
 
• These awards recognize acts of bravery, leadership, and exemplary service in the armed forces.
 
 
 
• **Aerial Defense in India**
 
 
• India's air defense system includes advanced fighter jets like the **Sukhoi Su-30MKI, Rafale, and Tejas**.
 
• India is also focusing on indigenous development of defense technologies under the **‘Make in India’ initiative**.
 
• Missile defense systems such as **Akash and BrahMos** are integral to India’s defense strategy.
